sectors.trend: Mixed: gold discoveries (Gateway, King River, Moonlight, Auric) and coal boom support sentiment; copper (True North) and lithium (ZhongNuo/Chariot) exploration active; tungsten (Viking) positive. However, 'distrust gold' in inflationary heat and oil-driven inflation pressure commodity-linked equities.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, A2M.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows amid rate uncertainty. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) supported by Chinese demand shift. Copper/lithium explorers (TSR.AX, ZNE.AX) offer speculative upside. Mineral Resources (MIN.AX) cleared by ASIC removes overhang.

sectors.trend: Negative. Mortgage stress at 18-year highs threatens NIMs and credit losses. CBA fined for inactive card fees erodes consumer trust. Rate hike fears pressure equity valuations but support net interest margins short-term. Housing downturn risks loan book quality.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cuts later in cycle and rising NPLs. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) highly vulnerable to 10% house price decline scenario.

sectors.trend: Positive. Coal booms as Chinese solar overtakes coal capacity globally but transition demand spikes. Premier urges Chinese/Indian coal firm merger, signalling policy support. Oil price spike fuels inflation but benefits energy producers.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BHP.AX (coal segment), AWE.AX benefit from coal demand. Oil-driven inflation supports energy equities but pressures RBA to hike, creating a mixed signal.

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Housing 'bloodbath' predicted with 10% price falls. Developer implosion (Bathla, mega developer) signals systemic property stress. Mortgage stress at 18-year highs. Consumer spending shifting to EVs over discretionary (holidays).
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX, VMC.AX) face refinancing risk. Property developers (DHG.AX, CGP.AX) at high default risk. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) relatively defensive but face margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Iran conflict 'bombs AI bubble' globally. Citi recommends buying tumbling tech. IREN pivots from Bitcoin to Microsoft GPU contracts. Canva faces employee privacy legal fight. Qantas strike vote threatens QAN.AX operations.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational risk from ground crew strike. CSL.AX (healthcare/tech) relatively insulated. Global tech weakness (MRVL, BILI, CSIQ) may drag ASX tech names.

key_themes: RBA rate hike cycle: fourth hike imminent, mortgage stress at 18-year highs, housing correction risk
Property sector stress: developer implosions, 10% house price decline forecast, 'Evergrande moment'
Commodity divergence: coal/gold strong, oil-driven inflation pressuring RBA, Chinese solar transition
Productivity crisis: 'bad to worse' performance, per capita recession despite headline GDP
Geopolitical risk: Iran-US conflict, Venezuela instability, oil price volatility
Mining exploration active: gold, copper, lithium, tungsten discoveries across WA/Qld/Nevada

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / mortgage stress / housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; favour cash-flowing staples; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance on rate path
Avoid speculative property developers; monitor Bathla and mega developer for contagion to construction/financials sector
Hedge with energy equities (WDS.AX, BHP.AX); monitor AUD/USD as oil-driven inflation pressures AUD
Favour dividend-paying large caps (CBA.AX, BHP.AX, CSL.AX) over growth; monitor GDP and retail sales data
Reduce QAN.AX exposure pending strike resolution; monitor travel sector sentiment
Diversify away from high-multiple tech; Citi suggests selective buying in quality tech names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and discovery catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Moonlight) plus $28M Auric profit; gold benefits from rate uncertainty and geopolitical risk

defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price decline forecast, 18-year high mortgage stress, developer implosions signal systemic property risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim QAN.AX ahead of potential strike

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD downside on oil-driven inflation
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil spike fuels inflation, pressures RBA to hike, but weakens AUD via growth concerns; monitor AUD/USD

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from rate hike fears, oil-driven inflation, housing stress, and developer contagion. Bond yields spiking. Expect ^AXJO to test support levels. Gold and coal relative outperformance likely. Qantas strike and property developer failures add volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Productivity crisis and per capita recession cap upside, but commodity strength (coal, gold, copper) and mining exploration pipeline support materials sector. Housing correction may create eventual value in REITs. RBA likely to peak rates within 6 months, supporting financials and property recovery by H2 2027.
